description: Destructive / exfiltration-capable app commands (permissions/destructive-commands.toml): delete_vault, export_backup, restore_backup, apply_update, relaunch_app; plus the process plugin's restart command (process:allow-restart — personal-cfo-867.1.2, ADR 0068), which relaunches the app after the real updater installs a new binary. Deliberately a SEPARATE capability from `default` (personal-cfo-3fdd.6, ADR 0010 addendum 2026-07-04): the trusted main window keeps the grant today (there are no other windows yet), but the future isolated windows (document_preview/agent_report — personal-cfo-2no/vrng/z6pn) must NEVER be added here. A compromised renderer in an isolated window then cannot delete the vault, exfiltrate a backup, or swap the binary even if it somehow reaches the invoke handler.
